60801.meaning1: having right view; with correct outlook; with correct belief

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo akkhaṇavedhī, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti. sammādiṭṭhi, sāḷha, ariyasāvako idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
pare micchādiṭṭhī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammādiṭṭhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60802.meaning1: who has correct belief; who has the right outlook

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso… anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā

60803.meaning1: undertaking actions based on correct beliefs

examples.text: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā

60804.meaning1: because of undertaking actions based on right view

examples.text: samaṇo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā sammādiṭṭhiko sammādiṭṭhikammasamādāno sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

60806.meaning1: dependent on right view; due to correct belief
60806.commentary: (SNa) sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'ti etthā'pi sammādiṭṭhisampayuttā vedanā'pi vaṭṭati, sammādiṭṭhiṃ upanissayaṃ katvā uppannā kusal'ākusalavedanā'pi vipākavedanā'pi.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena sammādiṭṭhi hoti, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.

60807.meaning1: with right view running in front; with correct outlook leading the way
60807.commentary: (SNa) sammādiṭṭhipurejavan'ti vipassanāsammādiṭṭhipurejavā assa pubbayāyikā'ti sammādiṭṭhipurejavo, taṃ sammādiṭṭhipurejavaṃ.

examples.text: hirī tassa apālambo, saty'assa parivāraṇaṃ, dhamm'āhaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi, sammādiṭṭhipurejavaṃ.
anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.

60812.meaning1: due to the subsiding of right view
60812.commentary: (PMa) sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitan'ti sammādiṭṭhivūpasamo nāma micchādiṭṭhi, tasmā yaṃ micchādiṭṭhipaccayā vedayitaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

60813.meaning1: complete wearing away of suffering; total extinction of stress

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti, uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.

60814.meaning1: leading to the complete wearing away of suffering; leading to the total extinction of stress

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti, uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ ayaṃ pañcamī upanisā bhāvanāya.

60815.meaningLit: gives a rain shower; offers a downpour

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

60817.synonym: ādara, garu, garukāra, gārava, cittikāra, cittīkāra, purekkhāra, sakkāra
60817.commentary: (APAa) lābhe ca tesaṃ alābhe ca kāyikacetasikasukhe c'eva tathā dukkhe ca sādarajanehi kate, sammāne c'eva omāne, ca sabbattha samako samānamānaso upekkhāpāramiṃ pūretvā uttamaṃ sambodhiṃ patto pāpuṇeyyan'ti attho.

examples.text: lābh'ālābhe sukhe dukkhe, sammāne c'āvamānane, sabbattha samako hutvā, patto sambodhim'uttamaṃ.
sammannatī'ti sammānaṃ karoti.

60818.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from sammāneti, caus

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, sammānanāya anavamānanāya anaticariyāya issariyavossaggena alaṅ'kār'ānuppadānena.

60819.meaning1: teaches well (wrt); instructs correctly (regarding); advises perfectly (about)
60819.commentary: (SNa) te ve maccā paralok'atthāya sammā anusāsantī'ti vadati.

examples.text: tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.

mātari ca pitari ca. imesu kho, bhikkhave, dvīsu sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavatī'ti.
gihissa v'āhaṃ, māṇava, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi. gihī vā hi, māṇava, pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

60822.meaning1: correct practice; going the right way; following the correct path

examples.text: sussūsā paripucchā paññāya āhāro, anuyogo paccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ āhāro, sammāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ āhāro

60823.meaning1: correct course; right path of action; right way

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho, sammāpaṭipadā. tasmā eso dhammo araṇo.
gihino v'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipadaṃ vaṇṇemi. gihi vā, bhikkhave, pabbajito vā sammāpaṭipanno sammāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan'ti.

60824.meaning1: practising correctly; going the right way
60824.meaning2: rightly disposed, having the right view

examples.text: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammāpaṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'ca anubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu pahit'attaṃ.

60826.meaning1: right resolve; proper aspiration; correct intention
60826.commentary: (SNPa) sammāpaṇidhī'ti tassa attano sammā paṇidhānaṃ niyuñjanaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.

60827.meaning1: having the right resolve; possessing the proper aspiration
60827.commentary: (SNPa) sammāpaṇidhī'ti tassa attano sammā paṇidhānaṃ niyuñjanaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.

60828.meaning1: well directed; correctly orientated; at a good angle

examples.text: na taṃ mātā pitā kayirā, aññe vā'pi ca ñātakā, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, seyyaso naṃ tato kare.

ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo kalyāṇassa kammassa kiriyāya kalyāṇassa kammassa pavattiyā'ti?… sammāpaṇihitaṃ kho, mahāli, cittaṃ hetu, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ paccayo kalyāṇassa kammassa kiriyāya kalyāṇassa kammassa pavattiyā.

60829.meaning1: fact of being well directed; fact of being correctly orientated; fact of being at a good angle

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? sammāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammāpaṇihitāya diṭṭhiyā sammāpaṇihitāya maggabhāvanāya avijjaṃ bhindati, vijjaṃ uppādeti, nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti?
ahañ'ca sīlasampanne, cirarattasamāhite, sammāpabbajite vande, brahmacariyaparāyane.

60831.meaning1: who correctly applies oneself; who engages in the right way

60833.commentary: (SNa) catūhi pariyaññehi yajitabbassa saddhiṃ bhūmiyā assamedhe vuttavibhavadakkhiṇassa yaññass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sammam'ettha pāsentī'ti sammāpāso.

examples.text: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.

60834.meaning1: due to proper attention; through right reflection
60834.meaning2: due to proper attention; through right reflection

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

60835.meaning1: correct intention; right volition; proper thought

examples.text: sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

60836.meaning1: with correct intention; having right volition; with proper thought

examples.text: pare micchāsaṅkappā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsaṅkappā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60837.meaning1: right mindfulness; perfect presence; correct awareness

examples.text: iti'ss'ime tayo dhammā sammādiṭṭhiṃ anuparidhāvanti anuparivattanti, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

60838.meaning1: with correct present moment awareness; having perfect memory

examples.text: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60839.meaning1: with correct present moment awareness; having perfect memory

examples.text: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60840.meaning1: perfect stability of mind; correct meditative composure

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo sammāsamādhiṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

60841.meaning1: having perfect stability of mind; with correct meditative composure

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo dūrepātī, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammāsamādhi hoti. sammāsamādhi, sāḷha, ariyasāvako yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ… n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
pare micchāsamādhi bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsamādhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60842.meaning1: dependent on perfect stability of mind

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

60843.meaning1: who has successfully achieved perfect stability of mind; with correct meditative composure

examples.text: sīlavato, bhikkhave, sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ

60844.meaningLit: discourse on perfect stability of mind

60845.meaning1: who has failed in perfect stability of mind; without correct meditative composure

examples.text: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, sīlavipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-vipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

60846.meaning1: due to the subsiding of correct meditative composure

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhivūpasama-paccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhivūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

60847.meaning1: perfectly awakened Buddha; fully enlightened being

examples.text: tass'idaṃ, bhikkhave, manussattaṃ laddhaṃ, tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, yattha dukkhaṃ nirujjhatī'ti.

60848.meaning1: preached by the perfectly awakened Buddha; taught by the fully enlightened being

examples.text: yamhā dhammaṃ vijāneyya, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, sakkaccaṃ taṃ namasseyya, aggihuttaṃ'va brāhmaṇo.
kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī, unnaḷā asamāhitā, na te dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite.

60849.meaning1: taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha

examples.text: evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.

60850.meaning1: teaching and training taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha

60851.meaning1: teachings of the perfectly awakened Buddha; religion of a fully enlightened being

examples.text: etañ'ce ruccati bhoto, sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ, mayam'pi pabbajissāma, varapaññassa santike.

60852.meaning1: disciple of the perfectly awakened Buddha; follower of the fully enlightened being

examples.text: evaṃ saṅkārabhūtesu, andhabhūte puthujjane, atirocati paññāya, sammāsambuddhasāvako.
api dibbesu kāmesu, ratiṃ so n'ādhigacchati, taṇhakkhayarato hoti, sammāsambuddhasāvako.

60853.meaningLit: discourse on the perfectly awakened Buddha

60854.meaningLit: discourse on the perfectly awakened Buddha

examples.text: nandī dukkhassa mūlan'ti, iti viditvā bhavā jāti bhūtassa jarāmaraṇan'ti. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, tathāgato sabbaso taṇhānaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho'ti vadāmī'ti.
eko'va loke anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho
pare micchāvācā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvācā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato catūhi vacīduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāvācā ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

60861.meaning1: with correct effort; having right endeavour

examples.text: pare micchāvāyāmā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvāyāmā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60862.meaning1: who is correctly liberated; who is rightly emancipated

examples.text: sammāvimuttassa, bhikkhave, micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti.

60863.meaning1: with a fully liberated mind; with properly emancipated heart

60864.commentary: (MNa) tadadhimutt'aṭṭhena sammāvimutti. (ANa) sammāvimuttiṃ phusatī'ti hetunā nayena arahattaphalavimuttiṃ ñāṇaphassena phusatī'ti.

examples.text: so abhijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, parijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, pajahanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, sacchikaronto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sammāvimuttiṃ phusati.
so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.

60865.meaning1: having correct liberation; with right emancipation

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo mahato kāyassa padāletā, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammāvimutti hoti. sammāvimutti, sāḷha, ariyasāvako mahantaṃ avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletī'ti.
pare micchāvimuttī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvimuttī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

60866.meaning1: dependent on right liberation; based on correct deliverance

examples.text: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te c'assa nijjiṇṇā honti. sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.

60867.meaning1: bends back; folds back; flexes back

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

60871.meaning1: bent back; folded back; flexed back

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

60872.meaning2: having bent back, having doubled up

60873.meaning1: could bend back; could fold back; could flex back

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

60875.meaning1: fake friend; pretend friend; fair-weather friend
60875.commentary: (DNa) sammiyasammiyo'ti samma sammā'ti vadanto sammukhe'y'eva sahāyo hoti, parammukhe verīsadiso otāram'eva gavesati. (DNt) sammiyasammiyo'ti vacanam'ettha atthī'ti sammiyasammiyo. ten'āha sammasammā'ti vadanto'ti.

examples.text: hoti pānasakhā nāma, hoti sammiyasammiyo, yo ca atthesu jātesu, sahāyo hoti so sakhā.

60876.commentary: (MNa) āmakacchinno'ti atitaruṇakāle chinno, so hi vāt'ātapena saṃphusati c'eva milāyati ca.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

60883.meaning1: face to face with; in the presence of

examples.text: yassa sammukhaciṇṇena, mittadhammo na labbhati, anusūyam'anakkosaṃ, saṇikaṃ tamhā apakkame'ti.

60885.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sammukha (+gen)
60885.meaning1: face to face (with); in front (of); in the presence (of)

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti yaṃ no āyasmā anuruddho bhagavato sammukhā yāva āsavānaṃ khayā pakāsetī'ti?
tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci sammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.

60886.meaning1: (vinaya) assigning ownership face to face; transferring ownership directly
60886.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) sammukhāvikappanā nāma imaṃ cīvaraṃ tuyhaṃ vikappemi itthan'nāmassa vā'ti.

examples.text: vikappanā nāma dve vikappanā, sammukhāvikappanā ca parammukhāvikappanā ca.

60887.meaning1: (vinaya) verdict in the presence (of); face to face settlement
60887.commentary: (ANa) dhammasammukhatā vinayasammukhatā saṅghasammukhatā puggalasammukhatā'ti imassa catubbidhassa sammukhībhāvassa vasena sammukhāvinayo paññatto.

examples.text: uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

60888.meaning1: face to face (with); in front (of); in the presence (of)

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli sabbaṃ taṃ temāsaṃ na bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ adāsi, yathā taṃ satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī.

60889.meaning1: meeting face to face (with); audience (with); showing face (to)

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli sabbaṃ taṃ temāsaṃ na bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ adāsi, yathā taṃ satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī.

60890.meaning1: time when meeting face to face; time when in the presence (of)

60892.meaning1: face to face (with); in front (of); in the presence (of)
